prompt: You hand $3$ snacks to every person at a table of $g$ guests plus $4$ helpers, using $33$ snacks in all. Solve $3(g + 4) = 33$ to find the number of guests $g$. Give just the number.
hint: Distribute: the $3$ snacks go to EVERYONE inside the parentheses — guests AND helpers.

hints.text: Distribute: the $3$ snacks go to EVERYONE inside the parentheses — guests AND helpers.

alternativeExplanations.title: Count heads first
steps: 33 snacks at 3 per person means $33 \div 3 = 11$ people got snacks.
4 of them are helpers, so $11 - 4 = 7$ are guests.
